problem: How can the business grow under a transition into retail, given revenue concentration risk and unclear strategy?
work: Defined the core by understanding their unique value
Created a unified brand identity built on their core
Created rituals that made the core part of day-to-day work, made progress transparent, and built a second line of leadership
Built processes across retail and manufacturing arms
output: A unified brand identity, embedded rituals, and a second line of leadership ready to own the growth journey.
outcome: Revenue grew 2x; retail saw 10x growth in 2 years. Culture of accountability and transparency strengthened via clear processes and consistent rituals.

problem: How to get 3x topline & 5x bottomline growth in 5 years?

outcome: Achieved 80% of the business plan. Shifted to an exclusive brand-store retail model. Built a structured, cause-and-effect approach to brand investment.
